dispositions.reason: WoW has one cast and GCD, with no two-hand spell composition or dual-cast resource surcharge. No extra potency, duration, or cost is invented.

PERK adds PerkMagickaRecovery1/2 abilities (006C3D0/006C3D1), whose EFIT magnitudes are +25/+50 magicka regeneration. Skyrim already regenerates the magicka spent on WoW spells; do not add a second service regen bonus.

PERK adds PerkAvoidDeathAbility (00A3F65) and its native death-ward script. WoW damage/heals change real Skyrim health, so the same emergency-heal ability observes it; there is no service-owned incoming-damage/day timer to duplicate.

Target Undead/vampire conditions on ModSpellMagnitude (+25%) and ModSpellDuration (+50%) can match keyword-free carrier spells. Leave these entry points to Skyrim; adding the same service modifiers would double-apply. Service amounts/timers are before this native target-only adjustment.

Ward Absorb changes incoming ward magicka absorption. WoW Power Word: Shield absorbs health damage, not spell magicka, and the plugin has no ward-collision event; do not turn shield healing into resource generation.

PERK grants native spell absorption (30%) or magic resistance (+10/+20/+30). Incoming Skyrim magic already uses these defenses. They do not increase outgoing WoW spells, and health carriers intentionally skip a second resist/absorb roll.

The unconditional Skyrim casting-sound entry point already makes native carrier casts silent for detection. WoW audiovisual effects are presentation; damaging an actor still provokes combat. Do not invent a threat reduction or invisibility modifier.

These adjust Illusion target-level caps or permit new creature types. Classic fear/sleep/charm have explicit target masks and resistance, not Skyrim level-cap magnitudes. Preserve those rules rather than changing durations or allowing forbidden targets. Hibernate remains the class-data Alteration utility override.

Requires a placed-rune range entry point. Hurricane is a channeled storm; Hunter traps are a different progression line and require trap ownership/placement mechanics. No class spell is treated as a Skyrim rune.

These are linked elemental critical-health/dual-cast secondary effects. The current combat protocol has no post-hit health fraction, disintegration, or dual-cast state; adding automatic fear, paralysis, execution or stagger to ordinary WoW hits would change their spell mechanics.

These require summoned/reanimated actor duration, health, count, bound-weapon identity, soul capture, or summon placement. The plugin has no pet/summoned-actor lifecycle. Rebirth revives an existing ally permanently, and forms transform the caster; neither is a temporary summon. Conjuration cost perks still affect the class line.

Native mace-specific armor penetration requires weapon identity. Feral attacks have no mace material/subtype, and the service spell-mod protocol has no armor-penetration op. Preserve target armor rather than reinterpreting penetration as arbitrary flat damage.
Needs sprint power-attack state and its critical proc. WoW Charge/Feral Charge are movement/control and have no corresponding critical weapon strike; no damage or crit is invented.

Requires backwards/sprinting/dual-wield power attacks, swing speed, paralysis or multi-target hit events absent from the class casting protocol. Existing Swipe/Whirlwind target counts and cast/attack timings remain their WoW values.

These belong to actual Skyrim shield use, projectile deflection, elemental blocking, movement, disarm/stagger and slow time. Native blocking keeps them; WoW Shield Bash is an interrupt and Shield Wall is percentage mitigation, not those physical shield events.

Native bow zoom/slow time, draw speed, stagger/paralysis, arrow recovery and aiming movement stay in Skyrim. There is no WoW ammunition/draw/aim event in the plugin; do not change spell cooldowns, ranges or apply a bow proc twice.

Prowl/Shadowmeld use real Skyrim sneak and detection. Native sneak skill, movement noise, traps, rolls and combat hide already apply there; do not turn detection percentages into extra damage, spell cost or a second stealth aura.

These improve crafted restoration potions, beneficial potion effects, ingredient knowledge, poison resistance, purity, weapon poison doses or harvesting. WoW heal spells are not brewed potions. Recipe casts only create items; current casting has no consumable-dose/inventory crafting event to multiply. Snakeblood already affects real Skyrim incoming poison.

Native worn-light-armor rating, matching/full-set checks, weight, stamina regeneration and hit avoidance already belong to Skyrim equipment. Mark/Barkskin/form armor are magical effects, not worn armor pieces; do not multiply them with equipment-only perks.

Native worn-heavy-armor rating, matching/full-set checks, weight, unarmed gauntlets, fall/stagger mitigation and reflected blows belong to Skyrim equipment/events. Feral paws are service attacks, not native gauntlet punches; no additional outgoing spell multiplier is implied.

These affect actual enchantment crafting, charges, soul capture and enchantment slots. Mark, Thorns and shaman imbues are temporary spell auras, not crafted Skyrim enchantments; do not grant them Enchanter potency or extra slots. Native enchanted items keep their normal perk-built values.
Material crafting/tempering and enchanting-item repair affect actual Skyrim equipment, not WoW spell magnitudes. The service never manufactures weapon stats from a smithing perk.

Lock difficulty, sweet spots, picks, loot and keys belong to the Skyrim lock interface. Knowing WoW Pick Lock neither bypasses Skyrim locks nor supplies a lock minigame result; no cost/damage spell modifier fits.

The native theft interface owns success, worn-item stealing, keys, capacity and reverse-pickpocket poisoning. WoW Pick Pocket does not implement that inventory/crime operation; no combat modifier fits.
Native buying/selling, persuasion, bribery, investment and stolen-goods rules own these benefits. Combat taunts/fears are not vendor prices or dialogue skill checks.
